name: Unimot S.A.
summary: Unimot S.A., an independent fuel importer, engages in the wholesale and distribution of diesel oil and other liquid fuels in Poland and internationally. The company distributes liquefied petroleum gas, natural gas, biofuels, electricity, bitumen products, and aviation and marine fuels, as well as propane-butane.
